Loss report: gitea -> argo

[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-2 step.action (the action org/tool@v2 has no Argo mapping; Argo does not run the step, and the marker and a comment keep the reference)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-3 step.action (the action org/local-action@main has no Argo mapping; Argo does not run the step, and the marker and a comment keep the reference)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-4 step.action (the action /checkout has no Argo mapping; Argo does not run the step, and the marker and a comment keep the reference)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.action: input git artifact at /workspace (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha workflow parameters carry the repository and the commit; a private repository needs credentials on the git artifact, which the file does not set; a private repository needs usernameSecret and passwordSecret, or sshPrivateKeySecret, on the git artifact; the file names none)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[external] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.push: EventSource webhook secret (Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token must exist and match the GitHub webhook; the repository owner and name are placeholders; set them in the EventSource)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build step.script: no-op container (the job runs no script, so a container named main carries its inputs and outputs)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.branches
